//: Copilot CLI project hook: after a git push, watch the CI run and repair it if red. Same script as the Claude Code hook in .claude/settings.json; see .claude/hooks/watch-ci-after-push.sh

postToolUse.bash: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; exec bash "$root/.claude/hooks/watch-ci-after-push.sh" copilot
